Android protects this setting for apps installed outside an app store. Open App info, tap ⋮ in the top corner, choose Allow restricted settings, then try again.
Pairly shows a small, quiet notification while it’s connected, and asks you there when your PC wants to mirror your screen.
Android requires apps to ask before they show notifications.
See, reply to and dismiss them from your PC
Every notification on your phone also appears on your PC. Reply to messages and dismiss notifications from there, and mute apps you don’t care about.
Reading notifications needs Android’s notification access. Pairly sends them only to your paired PC.
Turn on the switch for Pairly.
Read and reply to SMS from your PC
Your SMS conversations appear on your PC, and you can type replies on your keyboard. They’re sent from your phone as usual.
Pairly needs permission to read and send SMS.
See who’s calling and answer from your PC
When your phone rings, your PC shows who’s calling, and you can answer or decline right there.
Pairly needs phone access to notice calls, contacts to show the caller’s name, and permission to answer calls.
Browse your phone’s photos on your PC
Browse the photos and videos on your phone from your PC and save the ones you want.
Pairly needs access to your photos and videos to show them on your PC.
Send files between phone and PC
Send files from your PC to your phone and browse your phone’s storage from your PC.
To save received files and let your PC browse your storage, Android requires access to all files.
Turn on Allow access to manage all files.
Tap, scroll and type from your PC
While you mirror your phone’s screen, use your mouse and keyboard to control it.
Only accessibility services may tap and type for you. Pairly uses this only while you control the phone from your PC.
Open Installed apps (or Downloaded apps), then Pairly.
Turn on Use Pairly and confirm.
Mirror your screen when your PC asks
See your phone’s screen in a window on your PC. Android asks you to confirm every time before anything is shared.
Pairly needs to appear on top of other apps to show Android’s screen-sharing prompt while you’re using another app.
Turn on Allow display over other apps.
Keep the connection while the screen is off
Lets Pairly stay connected to your PC while your phone is locked, so notifications and calls arrive right away.
Battery optimization stops apps in the background. Pairly uses very little power while idle.
On Samsung phones, also remove Pairly from Sleeping apps.
Copy on one device, paste on the other
Text and images you copy on your PC appear on your phone, and the other way round. While Pairly is open this just works. To sync in the background, set up Shizuku once.
Android only lets the app on screen read the clipboard. Shizuku, a free helper app, lets Pairly read it in the background.

Five steps, about five minutes. Each step ticks itself off when it’s done. Come back here between steps.
Open Settings → About phone and tap Build number seven times until you see “You are now a developer”. On some phones it’s under Software information.
Connect to Wi-Fi. In Developer options, turn on Wireless debugging and confirm.
Shizuku is a free, open-source helper app. Install it from the Play Store or GitHub.

In Shizuku, tap Pairing under “Start via Wireless debugging”. Then in Wireless debugging, tap Pair device with pairing code and type the code into Shizuku’s notification. Finally tap Start in Shizuku.
Tap the button and choose Allow in Shizuku’s dialog.

My phone can’t find my PC

Make sure both are on the same Wi-Fi network, not a guest network. Pairly must be open on your PC, and Windows Firewall must allow Pairly on private networks. If your PC treats the Wi-Fi as Public, switch it to Private in the Windows network settings.
The connection drops when the screen is off
Allow Pairly to run in the background under Features → Stay connected. On Samsung, also remove Pairly from Sleeping apps; on Xiaomi, set Battery saver to No restrictions.
Android protects notification access and accessibility for apps installed outside an app store. Open App info → ⋮ → Allow restricted settings, then turn the setting on again.
The clipboard doesn’t sync in the background
Android only lets the visible app read the clipboard. Set up Shizuku under Features → Shared clipboard. After restarting your phone, open Shizuku and tap Start.
Android shares audio only from apps that allow it, and asks once for microphone access. Some apps, such as streaming services, block capture entirely.
Can I use more than one phone or PC?
One PC can connect several phones: just run the setup on each phone. Each phone pairs with one PC at a time; to switch, use Settings → Pair with another PC.
Yes. There’s no account and no cloud. Data travels directly between your devices over an encrypted connection that is pinned to your PC.
Pairly checks GitHub for new versions twice a day and installs them. The first update asks you to confirm; after that it updates silently on Android 12 and newer.
